mentions.name: Shapiful
mentions.description: This cloud-based platform lets users design and generate 3D-printable labels and custom objects such as personalized labels, signage, tags, stamps, LEGO-compatible pieces, and board game tiles by customizing shapes, text, braille, or QR codes. It supports uploading existing STL files with overlaid text or graphics, live 3D previews, parametric scaling, and automatic surface detection for easy placement. Multiple shapes, mounting styles, and text styles (embossed, debossed, engraved, or negative) are supported to produce durable, print-ready models.
mentions.problem: Removes the steep learning curve of traditional CAD tools while still delivering precise, print-ready models in minutes, turning 3D printing personalization from a technical chore into an intuitive creative process.
mentions.audience: Engineers, designers, educators, hobbyists, gardeners, and 3D printing enthusiasts who want fast, flexible customization without the complexity of traditional CAD software.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m working on Shapiful, a cloud-based platform that makes designing and generating 3D-printable labels and custom objects fast, simple, and accessible to everyone.
